final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and mainly reframed the same record more narrowly. That reframing is substantively more accurate than an unconditional readiness claim: the evidence supports aggregate readiness above threshold, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, and a remaining below-target weakness in a named launch use case. It also supports that draft monitoring and rollback ideas can be described only as draft mitigation. But the governing question is whether the current record proves the required disclosure or approved exception already exists. It does not. The policy requires material limitations for named launch use cases to be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance, and certification without material caveats requires either no remaining material weakness or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion. The record instead shows an unresolved underwriting weakness, an incomplete draft runbook, and a model-card draft that still says there are no known material limitations. That means the Actor's narrowed position is best understood as a recommendation for what would be needed to reach compliant_with_caveats, not proof that compliant_with_caveats has already been satisfied on the present record.
remaining_concerns: No new admissible evidence shows the model card was revised to disclose the property-insurance underwriting limitation as required before launch.
No admissible evidence shows approved risk acceptance for launching with the unresolved underwriting weakness.
The draft mitigation runbook remains incomplete because owner and alert threshold are still TBD, so it is not approved mitigation under the policy text.
The current model-card draft reportedly states there are no known material limitations, which conflicts with the evidence of a remaining named-use-case weakness.
A caveated certification may be a sensible recommendation, but on this record the caveat is still an unsatisfied compliance condition rather than proven compliance.
